name: OPD Credit
query:
SELECT DISTINCT 
    s.customer,
    s.patient,
    s.patient_name,
    SUM(s.outstanding_amount) AS balance
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` s
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabInpatient Record` ip ON s.patient = ip.patient
WHERE 
    s.posting_date BETWEEN "2026-02-15" AND "2026-02-15"
    AND s.bill_to_employee = 0
    AND s.is_inpatient = 0
    AND s.docstatus = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabInpatient Record` ip2
        WHERE ip2.patient = s.patient
        AND (
            (ip2.status IN ("Admitted" ,  "Discharge Scheduled") )  -- Exclude "Admitted" patients
        
            OR (
                ip2.status = "Discharged" 
                AND ip2.discharge_datetime >= "2026-02-15"  -- Exclude any previous discharges with discharge datetime >= {to_date}
            )
        )
    )
GROUP BY 
    s.customer, s.patient
HAVING 
    balance > 0
